Name: Critters on Artifact Spots
Author: HCO2017
Description:
This mod adds small critters near or on artifact spots to make them more noticeable.

There are two Variations of this mod which are [b]Static and Dynamic.
Static[/b] makes the critters stay in their place. their animations would still take place but they would not move from their spot.
[b]Dynamic[/b] makes the critters move around the Artifact spot.
[s][/s]Personally, I would pick the static version.


Also, there are three types of critters that can be used.
The regular beetles are small and show up in spring, summer and fall.
The winter beetles are slightly larger and show up in Winter.
The sand ants appear in the desert and the beach and show up in spring, summer and fall.

I would highly recommend installing the mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18/?][i]Animal Crossing Digspots[/i][/url] along with this mod.

[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
You would need the latest version of [url=http://https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases][i]SMAPI[/i][/url], and the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/?][i]CustomCritters[/i][/url] for this mod to work.
Paste the folders named "hco.beetles", "hco.winterbeetles" and "hco.sand_ants" in
stardew valley/Mods/CustomCritters/Critters.

Happy Modding!
